title: Tunisian Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy wrap filled with chicken, vegetables, and a hint of Tunisian spices.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the coconut oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and let rest for 2 minutes.
In the same skillet, add the Tunisian chili paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red onion and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the yogurt on the tortilla, then adding the chicken, onion mixture, cucumber, tomato, and cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
